name: ladder_10_20
rationale: Stop ladder: halve a short at +10%, exit at +20%: smoother loss path in squeezes than one binary stop.

name: short_invvol
rationale: Size shorts by 1/idio336 (clipped 0.5x..2x equal weight) so the jumpiest names carry less $ risk. Earlier inverse-vol test was both legs vs LIVE; this is short leg only vs B.

name: short_clusterw
rationale: Concentration: weight each short ∝ 1/(1+sum_j max(rho_ij,0)) using 336h residual correlations among the shorts, so correlated clusters (same narrative/sector) share one risk budget.

name: short_minvar
rationale: Minimum-variance short leg: w ∝ Σ^-1 1 on 336h residual cov (50% shrink to diagonal), negatives clipped, cap 2x equal.

name: hedge_crashbeta
rationale: 2022-06-13: 168h beta overstated shorts' crash participation. Beta estimated only on hours with |r_BTC| > rolling-720h sd(r_BTC), 720h window (fallback 168h beta).

name: hedge_downbeta
rationale: Asymmetric hedge: use downside beta (hours with r_BTC<0, 336h window) - the beta relevant for crash days.

name: hedge_4hbeta
rationale: Microstructure: 1h returns of alts lag BTC (asynchronous trading) -> biased 1h betas. Use beta from overlapping 4h returns, 672h window.

name: hedge_dimson
rationale: Dimson beta (beta on r_BTC,t + beta on r_BTC,t-1, 168h) corrects the same lag bias in 1h returns.

name: hedge_btceth
rationale: Two-factor hedge: bivariate regression of each coin on BTC and ETH (168h); hedge both. Alt beta is partly ETH beta; better factor fit -> smaller hedge error in tails.

name: pc_adj_0.5
rationale: Gradual rebalance: trade half-way toward targets each 8h rebalance; smoother turnover and less whipsaw.

name: pc_riskparity_legs
rationale: Risk-parity legs: set long/short leg gross inversely proportional to average idio of the leg names (total gross 1). Expected to hurt (alpha in short leg) - included because asked.

name: ex_disp
rationale: Cross-sectional dispersion of 24h residual returns in M high = squeeze/pump environment; gross = clip(median_90d(disp)/disp,0.5,1), daily, lagged 1d.

name: ex_fund_q0.8
rationale: Aggregate funding in M (crowded leveraged alt longs = alt-season) predicts short squeezes; gross 0.5 when mean M funding > expanding q-quantile of its own past (min 60d), lagged.

name: ex_fund_q0.9
rationale: as T28

name: ex_altseason_q0.8
rationale: Alt-season indicator: median over M of 336h cumulative residual return (alts beating their BTC beta). Mar 2021 squeeze was alt-season. Gross 0.5 when indicator > expanding q-quantile (lagged). Differs from tried BTC-trend throttle.

name: ex_altseason_q0.9
rationale: as T30

name: ex_altseason_short
rationale: As T30 q0.8 but de-risk only the short leg (short leg 0.55->0.30 of leg gross) instead of all gross.

name: tranche2
rationale: Rebalance-timing luck: run the book as 2 tranches rebalanced at offsets 0h and 4h (each half capital). Same signal, smoother path, lower dependence on the 8h grid (Hoffstein timing-luck).

name: volstop
rationale: Fixed 20% stop fires far more often on jumpy names (noise) than calm ones. Per-name stop = 0.2*idio_s/median(idio of shorts), clip [0.1,0.4], set at rebalance.

name: minvar_adj
rationale: Combine two best risk-construction ideas from round 1 (minvar short leg, halfway rebalance): both reduce concentration/whipsaw, mechanisms independent.

name: short_invbeta
